overview: Build a LEGO-style minifigure hero holding an energy sword: 1 white-clad body with 1 blond hair/helmet-like top, 2 arms posed forward, and 1 cylindrical-hilt sword with a long blade.

subassemblies.name: Head + Hair
subassemblies.description: 1 head block (approx 2x2x2) with 2 printed eyes + 1 mouth/line on the front; 1 blond hair mass built as a rounded cap using 6–8 curved/cheese slopes around the top and sides.

subassemblies.name: Torso + Belt
subassemblies.description: 1 torso core (approx 2 studs wide x 2 studs deep x 3 bricks tall) in white; 1 brown belt band around the waist (1 plate layer) with 1 small front pouch/accent.

subassemblies.name: Arms + Hands (2)
subassemblies.description: 2 arms built as 1x1/1x2 white segments each; 2 hands/claws (or small brackets) positioned together in front of the torso to grip the hilt.
subassemblies.imageRegion: middle area, right of torso (forearms and hands)

subassemblies.name: Legs + Feet (2)
subassemblies.description: 2 legs in a walking stance: each leg ~2 studs wide with 1 blocky foot; add 2 tan/gold accent tiles/plates on the outer shins to mimic printed markings.

subassemblies.name: Energy Sword (Hilt + Blade)
subassemblies.description: 1 cylindrical hilt (silver/gray look) built from stacked round bricks/1x1 rounds and small rings; 1 long blade made as a tapered light-blue bar using stacked 1x1 plates/tiles or a thin column (about 6–10 segments).
subassemblies.imageRegion: right side, from mid-height to top-right corner
